items.title: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. Discovery takeover for months
items.summary: Paramount says its takeover of CNN’s parent company, Warner Bros. Discovery, will be delayed for many months, and potentially well into 2027, due to pending lawsuits by state attorneys general and the Writers Guild of America.
